scope: Admission + approval. The P1 subset is the delivered single-resource admission/quota vocabulary; the P2 extension adds persistent proposal approval and cumulative budget settlement. P2 fields are additive: a P1 client ignores them and P1 semantics never change.

rules: an executable upper bound is mandatory in quota-only mode; an unbounded request is refused (unbounded_request), never silently admitted
usage-only must be explicitly requested by an administrator; it is never a fallback from a failed quota-only admission
admission happens once per attempt, before dispatch
release happens exactly once on terminal state or pre-dispatch refusal
quota checks and reservations are transactional; a race never over-admits
p1.model_token_note: P1 does not proxy or enforce model token budgets. A model provider budget proxy is C-owned (C T-13) and is not a Runtime resource ledger.

p2_additive.compatibility_rule: every P2 field is optional and namespaced under its own object; a P1 reader ignores it and a P2 writer never changes the meaning of a P1 field

approval.resource: Proposal/ResearchRecord approval (typed Data resource for the record; Runtime for the approval facts)

plan_digest.description: the approval binds the frozen scientific plan; a plan change invalidates the approval

approver_ref.description: server-resolved approving principal; never a payload claim

rules: at most one pending approval per (proposal_ref, plan_digest); a duplicate request replays the existing approval_ref
the approver identity comes from the authenticated channel and must hold the approval permission; a payload approver/role/tenant is refused (access_denied, params.rule=approver_identity_from_payload)
an approval authorizes exactly one plan_digest; a different digest requires a new approval
revoke is terminal for future submits; an already-dispatched attempt is governed by control semantics, not by the approval
reject/revoke keep the record readable (append-only history), never delete it
an approval decision is one CAS on expected_revision

persistence.unique_rule: at most one pending approval per (requester_principal, proposal_ref, plan_digest); a replay returns the same approval_ref
persistence.events: approval.* facts committed to the existing job_outbox table in the same transaction as the state CAS

approval.authorization: read: scope read; request: scope write; decide/revoke: approval permission with a verified human principal

rules: authorize before reserve; reserve before dispatch; settle after terminal
a cumulative cap is never exceeded by concurrent submissions (transactional check)
usage facts are recorded separately from the scientific result; a metering failure never blocks completion
a duplicate or out-of-order usage fact is idempotent per (attempt, meter_ref, fact_id)
released capacity returns to the ledger exactly once
budget exhaustion is authorization (access_denied), never a scientific failure

waiting.rule: waiting is reported as a reason on status plus a bounded cursor query; a client never infers waiting from silence
